note: Alberta Parks campground 4 km north of Sylvan Lake off Highway 20: well-treed loops above the lake with no direct lake access (the main beach is a short drive away in the town of Sylvan Lake), trails, two playgrounds, an amphitheatre and an RV fill station at the entrance. The lakeshore viewing platform nearest site 129 has been closed since August 2025. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on the Alberta Parks page and shop: 2026 season May 8 - Sep 29, 192 power + 1 power/water sites at C$42 / C$50, 15/30 A, reservable 90 days (row values), FCFS at sites 186-195 from Sep 7 2026, facilities. Wrote fees (high 42->50), season (05-08/09-29), booking note, sites (max 122 ft, pull-through), hookups, facilities (+dump, vault, store); note cleaned. Facility Operator 'KR Campground Maintenance' (no phone), Information 403-887-5522 (stored). No seniors-discount line on the campground page.

ADVISORY: 'Construction Closure - Lakeshore Trail Lookout Closed', effective August 27, 2025 until further notice ('the viewing platform closest to site 129 is closed'). A trail feature, not a campground closure; mentioned in the note.

PIN (52.34396,-114.08547): in the middle of the main loops on imagery. The shop's GPS 52.34637,-114.08579 (~270 m N) is the entrance on Township Road 392. No move.
